questions.q: Who voices Goku in the Japanese versions of Dragon Ball?
questions.why: Masako Nozawa voices Goku, and also his sons Gohan and Goten and his father Bardock.

questions.q: Which signature energy attack did Goku learn from the Turtle Hermit?
questions.why: The Kamehameha is named for a Hawaiian king and taught by Roshi.

questions.q: Who raised Goku before he met Bulma?
questions.why: His adoptive grandfather, a hermit martial artist, found and raised him.

questions.q: Goku was loosely modeled on Sun Wukong from which Chinese novel?
questions.why: Dragon Ball took its starting idea from Wu Cheng'en's Journey to the West.

questions.q: Who taught Goku the Spirit Bomb?
questions.why: King Kai trained Goku in Other World and taught him the technique that gathers energy from living things.

questions.q: In what year did Goku debut in Weekly Shōnen Jump?
questions.why: Chapter 1 of Dragon Ball ran in late 1984.

questions.q: Goku learned Instant Transmission from the inhabitants of which planet?
questions.why: The Yardrat people teach him the teleportation skill known as Instant Transmission.

questions.q: Who plays adult Goku in the Funimation English dub?
questions.why: Sean Schemmel voices adult Goku, while Masako Nozawa plays him in Japanese.

questions.q: What did Toriyama say inspired the colour of Goku's training gi?
questions.why: The orange outfit came from Buddhist robes, giving the series a Chinese flavour.

questions.q: Goku received the Flying Nimbus as a reward from which character?
questions.why: Roshi gave him Kinto'un for rescuing his sea turtle.
